channel.title: San Diego Community Newsgroup - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from San Diego Community Newsgroup (sdnews.com)

item.title: San Diego gas prices surge amid Middle East tensions
item.description: San Diego drivers are feeling the pinch at the pump as the average price of a gallon of self-serve regular gasoline jumped 10.4 cents Friday to $4.998.

item.title: Opinion: A tax for Balboa Park will wait until 2028. But it’s time to fund the park.
item.description: City leaders keep pushing revenue measures that don't respond to what resident concerns. A new tax that solves Balboa Park's problems will.

item.title: California’s next insurance commissioner will have ‘brutal’ balancing act
item.description: "There is no other task in any office in the state of California, except the governor, that has such significant power."

item.title: Main gate at Camp Pendleton closed for several hours after package found
item.description: The main Camp Pendleton gate temporarily closed Friday because of an "unattended package" discovered near the base.

item.title: Peninsula Beacon: March 6, 2026
item.description: The Peninsula Beacon covers stories highlighting Ocean Beach residents' concerns over the city's Heritage Preservation Program update, fearing increased housing density after reducing the historic district. Additional coverage includes Sunset Cliffs closures due to erosion, a Rotary Club comedy fundraiser, and a 'Salute to Service' show honoring first responders.

item.title: Uptown News: March 6, 2026
item.description: Uptown News covers Hillcrest's vibrant Chinese Lunar New Year celebrations, featuring parades and the Lantern Festival. It also highlights the Junior League's second 'Artists in the House' event on April 4, showcasing DEIB-themed art. Additional stories address local restaurant closures amid economic woes and a Little Italy tower foreclosure.

item.title: Videos: San Diego-based warships support U.S. military action in Iran
item.description: Videos show aircraft operations aboard the nuclear-powered carrier USS Abraham Lincoln and the guided-missile destroyer USS Spruance firing cruise missiles.

item.title: Downtown News: March 6, 2026
item.description: Downtown News features baseball season excitement in East Village, highlighting Padres' spring training and fan events. It covers restaurant closures impacting local dining, Little Italy's March festivities, a Paris-inspired downtown spot, and the 2026 High School Hospitality Conference at Rady Shell, fostering student career exploration in the industry.

item.title: Issa retires, shaking up political map while endorsing Desmond in his shift to 48th District
item.description: Desmond's entry into the 48th race shakes up an already-shifting political map after voters overwhelmingly approved Prop. 50 last year.

item.title: Bailey, supporters unveil initiative to overturn Balboa Park paid parking
item.description: A group led by former Coronado Mayor and current District 2 candidate Richard Bailey filed paperwork Friday to begin collecting signatures.
